suggested_experiment_name: QUALIPHIDE (Quantum Limited Amplification for Photon-Hidden sector Interaction Dark matter Experiment)
coupling_convention: Kinetic mixing parameter χ (dimensionless), canonical dark photon coupling
notes: QUALIPHIDE reports 95% confidence limits on hidden photon kinetic mixing parameter χ in the mass range [1.97, 3.05]×10^-5 eV. The paper states 'excluding a kinetic mixing parameter χ at the 95% confidence level to just over 10^-12 across that frequency range' (3.9–7.4 GHz). The limit is approximately χ ≈ 1.0×10^-12 across the measured mass range. This is encoded as a horizontal line (mass-independent bound valid over the stated mass range). The experiment uses a cryogenic dish haloscope with quantum-limited TW-KIPA amplification. Standard DM density ρ_DM = 0.3 GeV/cm³ is assumed per Eq. 1. No robust signal detected; limits are exclusion bounds. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.75, 79)) | Vision: FIG. 5 shows 95% confidence limits on kinetic mixing parameter χ vs mass in μeV c⁻². The x-axis is labeled 'Mass [μeV c⁻²]' spanning 0–40 μeV c⁻². The y-axis is log-scale kinetic mixing χ spanning 10⁻¹⁴ to 10⁻⁸. The QUALIPHIDE constraint (gray shaded region) forms the lower boundary of the exclusion region. The boundary shows a characteristic V-shaped dip centered around 2–3 μeV, with steep walls rising on both sides. The minimum coupling achieved is ~1–2 × 10⁻¹⁴ at the dip center. The plot overlays multiple other experiments (WISPDMX, ADMX, SHUKET, CAPP, DM-Pathfinder, HAYSTAC, SQuAD) for comparison. Tracing was performed by identifying the lower envelope of the gray QUALIPHIDE region across the mass range, sampling more densely near the V-shaped minimum and less densely on the rising flanks.
